officialSources.observation: Official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer. Its current HTML exposes State, District, Sub Div, Circle, Mauza, Survey Type, Map Instance and Sheet No selectors; inspected JavaScript uses same-host REST and WMS routes.
Official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms gateway linking Bhu-Naksha and online land-record services.
Official Directorate of Land Records and Survey page listing Online Map and related survey services.

requests.outcome: Current configuration used relative same-host routes; no credentials or private tokens observed.
Inspected current JavaScript route and parameter names, including REST level selection, MapInfo extent, ScalarDatahandler and WMS.
Returned Bihar hierarchy; Khagaria native district code 21 was observed.
Returned subdivision 01 and Alauli circle code 04.
Returned Alauli mauza 0100, survey type CS, map instance 06 and sheets 01-05. The native selection path is 21/01/04/0100/CS/06/{sheet}.

Returned EPSG:32645 sheet extent and gisCode CS21010401001980601. Tested sheet extents were bounded around 439-442 km E; the exact WUP point transforms to about 435822 E, outside these tested extents, so no point-hit inference was made.

Returned a bounded anonymous map probe with native plot identifier mOuJBivaQLyCTF2v7o8xqg and plot number 344, but no geometry; the identifier was not retained as a sample because a safe parcel polygon response was not obtained.
Anonymous capabilities request returned server error; no retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token or TLS exception was used.
Anonymous plot lookup route returned unauthorized for the tested request; this is an access limitation, not evidence of parcel absence.

registryBasis: Official Bihar BhuNaksha provides a local cadastral-map hierarchy that resolves Khagaria district, Alauli circle and Alauli mauza, with public map extents and a bounded plot probe. This establishes an official local/state registry route, but not citywide open parcel geometry coverage.
